context.body: Luke gives this discourse a distinct setting and a blessing-and-woe structure.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus stands on a level place among disciples and a crowd, heals, and addresses the poor, hungry, weeping, and rejected.
observations.label: Luke places blessings and woes on a level place: action

observations.body: Four blessings are followed by four woes directed to the rich, full, laughing, and well-spoken-of.
observations.label: Luke places blessings and woes on a level place: response

observations.body: level place · poor · hungry · weep · rejoice · woe · rich
observations.label: Words in Luke 6:17–26

payload.posture: Read Luke 6:17–26 as teachings in other settings evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The setting and wording must not be silently imported into Matthew’s mountain discourse.
payload.title: Luke places blessings and woes on a level place
